name: A&B BNN ReActNet-18 (ImageNet, step2)
numerical_verification: passed (host); device: pre-merge runtime bit-exact on S22, post-merge pending (physical device)

headline.note: 128-sample smoke test, not an ImageNet estimate

int8_full.note: per-tensor asymmetric int8 activations; eval5000 54.96% vs exact neon 58.42% (-3.46 pt, p=5e-12); emulated 124.06 M instructions

8-bit log2 residual stream, BN+residual+PReLU+encode fused into I8BConv2DRes, stem written in l8 once (python/bitino/quantize_l8.py, --stem l8); eval5000 58.08% (-0.34 pt vs exact, p=0.41); emulated 95.35 M instructions (optimized 117.81 M). Earlier version (stem split, 115.89 M): eval5000 57.88%, +2.92 pt vs int8_full (p=2.9e-9), S22 byte-identical to its emulated reference, throttled S22 (X2 cap 1.17 GHz) t1 24.0 vs 25.9 ms, t4 11.7 vs 15.6 ms. Current version not yet run on the device.

instructions_M.method: qemu-aarch64 TCG plugin, 1 thread, -cpu max, (warmup 1 + 2 it) - (warmup 1 + 1 it); instruction counts, not latency
instructions_M.note: exact executed ARM instructions per inference under qemu (not cycles, not latency)
